{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted
conversion_rate = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Compute exact count of converted loyal customers
converted_count = loyal_df['converted'].sum()

# Output both count and rate
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {len(loyal_df)}")
print(f"Number of converted orders among loyal customers: {converted_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate}")"}
